TOPIC
    about_PSBuildTestFixture

SHORT DESCRIPTION
    Describes the hand-written about topic the PSBuildTestFixture module ships.

LONG DESCRIPTION
    This is a hand-written about topic, written in the structure Get-Help documents:
    a TOPIC line, a SHORT DESCRIPTION, and four-space-indented body text.

    It exists so the test suite can tell a conformant about topic apart from a Markdown
    readme copied over the top of one. A build that converts the readme into about help
    must leave this file alone and say so, in compile and non-compile mode alike. See
    psake/PowerShellBuild#210 and psake/PowerShellBuild#212.

KEYWORDS
    PSBuildTestFixture

SEE ALSO
    Get-Widget
    Set-Widget
